initialization: cold, no saved point or basis
equality_bounds_and_dual_checks: All strengthened numerical KKT<=1e-9, all original primal<=1e-9; exact signs, infinite-bound zero multipliers; no dual edit.
finite_return: Untouched binary64 primal/marginals and exact certificates; all failure, timeout, representation overflow, source/input/audit mismatch terminate without reuse or retry.
classification: Integrated source-derived total-resource accounting; no scientific array evaluation or runtime prediction
source_hashing: Owner and every child verify the complete source freeze. Generated predecessor files are additionally hashed by manifest and each referenced cache proof; all I/O is charged to the same stage clock.
memory_policy: One scientific worker plus owner and supervisor. Worker RLIMIT_AS hard39.5GiB, each helper soft256MiB with no helper-side increase. Worker inherits a40GiB hard ceiling and lowers it before import. Producer and auditor are sequential. All Python objects, sparse copies, native solver/model allocation and imported runtimes count; allocation failure is terminal.
disk_policy: Monitor total stage output and reject/kill on cap crossing; RLIMIT_FSIZE additionally caps each file. Polling can overshoot aggregate cap before rejection. Source-derived output arrays/trace are below cap; acceptance requires aggregate within cap. No retry.
output_inventory: Full augmented CSR, equality and RHS/cost/bounds; separate hard CSR/RHS/kappa/original-id cache and <=31395 box records; 78791 primal, 968126 raw marginal scalars, full residuals and compact proofs/logs. No per-row exact fraction cache is serialized.
simultaneous_peak_inventory: Original state/P/M/H; producer dyadic and independent Fraction tangent caches each <=1601145 output coefficients plus <=31395 physical coefficients; packed hard buffers, hard/full CSR and sparse-copy temporaries, RHS/bounds and exact return point. Solver factorization/internal buffers share the hard worker cap.
net_savings: Actual J*P/row composition, finite coefficient encoding and independent input audit run only once in A. Audited encoded primary guards and upward kappa are reused in B; C uses the new B physical trace, avoiding J*P rebuilding.
